home.heroLead: Dune buggies, vineyard sunsets, and nights by the oasis — planned around your pace.
home.whyHeadline: Ica isn't a stop between cities. It's the reason you came south.
home.whySupport: Stay for the dunes, the wine, and the slow morning after.
home.featuredLead: Highlights from Huacachina, Paracas, and Nazca.
home.pitchHeadline: A day in Ica isn't improvised. It's built with you.
home.pitchBeat1: Transfers and timing at the group's pace — no queue, no rigid package.
home.pitchBeat2: Oasis, reserve, or lines: you pick the axis; we handle the rest of the day.
home.pitchBeat3: One thread to book. A clear confirmation. The desert, on your hour.

about.heroTitle: The desert is the destination, not the shortcut.
about.heroLead: Three owners. Based in Ica. Huacachina, Paracas, and Nazca, at the group's pace.
about.manifestoHeadline: Ica isn't a place you pass through.
about.manifestoP1: You come down, wait for the heat, and leave when the group is ready.
about.manifestoP2: Desértica exists so the desert is the reason for the trip, not the stretch between two cities.
about.quoteB: The desert, up close, every day.
about.mapLead: The department is the map. Oasis, reserve, and lines leave from Ica — not from a stop in the south.
about.motivaP1: What moves us is staying. Not a package that “hits Ica” and moves on. The heat on the dune, the slow morning by the oasis, the day that runs long if the group isn't ready to leave.
about.motivaP2: One thread to book. Confirmation before the engine starts. Meet in Ica, until the work asks otherwise. Guides in Spanish and English. Private days and group days — both — without selling the whole south in a morning or leaving the price for the dune.
about.motivaP3: We're just starting, and we want to grow here: more days built well, more of our own archive, more craft in Huacachina, Paracas, and Nazca. Not an agency that comes down on Sunday. Stay as long as the desert asks.
about.craftMeet: For now, we meet in Ica.
about.archiveLead: The archive fills as we go out.
about.closerLead: Huacachina, Paracas, and Nazca. You pick the axis; we handle the rest.

buggy.title: Dune buggy
buggy.body: A run across the open sand, with photo stops on the ridges.

board.title: Sandboard
board.body: A board to ride belly-down. Beginner-friendly, not standing.

helmet.title: Helmet
helmet.body: Helmets on for the buggy. Say so if you need a different size.

light.title: Low light
light.body: We stay out until the light drops. Clouds happen; the hour still holds.

meet.title: Meet in Ica
meet.body: The day starts in Ica, not a pickup from Lima.

group.title: Small group
group.body: Shared buggies. Room to hear the guide without a convoy.

lang.title: Spanish and English
lang.body: Guides in both. Say which you want when you book.

private.title: Private if you ask
private.body: A quieter run, slower if you need it. Tell us ahead.

pace.title: It can feel like a roller coaster
pace.body: The dunes move. If you want it calm, book private.

meet.title: Meeting point
meet.body: Ica. Be ready ten minutes early.

dunes.title: Dunes
dunes.body: Buggy across the ridges, with stops for photos.

light.title: Low light

close.title: Close

notes.intensity: The buggy can feel extreme. Private is slower if you ask in advance.
notes.kids: Young children and anyone who wants a quiet ride should go private.
notes.weather: Most days are clear. We stay until sunset even if the sky is flat.
